text: I rarely write reviews, but when I have a service as I had today I’m compelled to do so. Chris, of Go Flow Plumbing is great - he’s professional, personable and willing to share his knowledge. My communication with Go Flow was perfect and the frozen gas valve replacement by Chris expertly done. I have found my go to plumbing company.

Great experience having GoFlow replace my gas-fired hot water heater with an electric heat pump: a very reasonable and competitive estimate (including a no-cost pre-installation site visit), informative and cordial communication, flexible scheduling, on-time arrival, high attention to safety and Santa Rosa city requirements, and a neat and tidy installation. Placement of the new unit required some creative drain and pipe work, all done with a smile and no added expense. As luck would have it, our street-side water main developed a significant leak the day before the water heater was to be installed. A desperate call to GoFlow put THAT fix on the schedule as well... same day, a couple extra hours, and again a reasonable charge. I could not be happier and recommend GoFlow without hesitation. Kudos to both Chris (the man with the wrench) and Adam (the man on the office phone) for running a truly professional, customer focused and community minded business!

Received a detailed estimate and the work was scheduled professionally. Received prompt service. When changes came up, they handled them with approval quickly and did not need me to manage them. Completed the work with above and beyond service and expert skills. Highly recommend!

GoFlow Plumbing did an outstanding job servicing our water heater for our condo in Novato. They were professional, thorough, and took the time to explain everything they found and the work they completed. I also appreciated that they provided helpful recommendations and trusted referrals for other items that may need attention in the future, without any pressure. I highly recommend GoFlow Plumbing for their quality workmanship, honesty, and excellent customer service.

We have been in our San Anselmo home for 45 years and have done major remodels and countless simple home repairs. Hands down Chris at Goflow was the best plumbing contractor we've used and I know them all. We required a full water supply line replacement that was a challenging project. He was knowledgeable, persistent, and hardworking...and the pricing was very reasonable. Highly recommend.

Adam and his crew took care of a stubborn leak that multiple other companies could not handle. Shout out to him and his crew for their expertise in assessing the problem and quickly resolving it. Couldn't recommend these guys enough!!!
Go flow Plumbing was very professional and easy to work with they were fast, reliable and had very fair pricing!
Super professional! Very kind! Helped me with installing a reverse osmosis water machine and a new kitchen faucet. They guys are great!
This team was super kind and accommodating! They did a great job with a faucet replacement and installation of a new reverse osmosis water filter. I highly recommend them!

Fantastic experience. They got back to me immediately on my request and was able to come the next morning. Chris took care of both of my issues very quickly and was lovely to deal with. I would happily recommend them and we'll plan to use go flow in the future.

Adam was very helpful with scheduling and communication. Chris gave us great information and was able to get our job done quickly! Everything looks and works great! Thank you, both! We'll call again for our next plumbing need.
Timely, responsive, professional. Fair pricing. All good things to say and would hire again. Thanks guys!

Chris, with GOFLOW Plumbing has helped me over the past few years with indoor plumbing, outdoor pipe issues and he replaced my water heater. Chris is very professional, honest and reliable. I highly recommend GOFLOW Plumbing.

It was my first time using GOFLOW and I am so impressed. On time, pleasant and professional. Chris got my drain unclogged and repaired my shower handle at a very reasonable price. I'm sure I will be calling them again!

GOFLOW Plumbing has helped us at Empower Building Solutions with the plumbing for a few bathroom remodel projects we have completed. One being in Sonoma and the other in Marin County. Every time they have been responsive, professional, and complete quality work. We will definitely use them again and would recommend them to anyone looking for a quality plumbing company.

GoFlo Plumbing is our family's highly recommended plumber in Cotati and Sonoma County area. Chris was professional, efficient, great communication and intelligent. Chris came up with solution's to get our newly remodeled bathroom not only working properly with new fixtures, but resolving old plumbing issues and completing quickly with very clean, solid work. Confidently can say our bath and shower will keep flowing and we can sleep good at night knowing there will be no leaks flowing in the future. Thank you GoFlo team! Crystal & Family

I can't say enough good things about these guys! My water heater started leaking Thursday night—right before family were to arrive for the weekend. I was panicking but they got someone out to my place in Oakmont first thing Friday. I had a brand new water heater before they arrived. Seriously saved my weekend! Chris was super professional and explained everything he was doing. I'm so grateful they were able to squeeze me in on such short notice. Thank you thank you thank you!!

I got a great deal and everything fixed in a timely manner. I couldn't have asked for a better plumbing service. Chris, who I believe is the owner, was very friendly and professional. I would definitely recommend this company for any first time customers as you will find the only plumber you need to call.

I thought I had a crimped water line requiring trenching. Chris came out and determined the pressure valve needed cleaning. He didn't even push a replacement. Water flow in the house is now fantastic.

Great experience with GOFLOW Plumbing. They do high-quality work and stand behind everything they do. Chris was super easy to work with and made the whole job stress-free. I'll be using them again for sure.
I am really happy with the service I received from GOFLOW Plumbing. Chris was great to work with and everything turned out perfectly.
Great communication, thorough work, highly recommend!
Chris knows what he's doing, is very conscientious and takes all the time necessary to get the job done right. His prices are the most reasonable I've found. He's my new plumber, highly recommended.

Chris was prompt to reply to your texts. Chris was conscientious about letting you know he was going to be a little late and why. He was very polite, clean and organized. The job was completed faster than I expected. I am extremely pleased with his work and will highly recommend him. Would not hesitate to used him again. He also had a very competitive price.
